Can you confirm which path you prefer and an estimated timeline for each gate? I can then convert this into a mutual action plan and share a calendar with owners.

Diego — thanks, good notes. Short answers below:

- Commercial path: For a pilot we'll take a card payment if the value is <= $50k. Any commitment beyond that will require a PO and MPA.
- Legal review: Our legal lead (George Lin) will handle the MPA review. Typical turnaround is 10–12 business days but can be faster for small pilots.
- Security: Attached is our standard questionnaire — we've asked you to fill and return. Our security team will do a focused review (usually 5–7 business days once we get the completed questionnaire).
- Finance: PO issuance is Net30. Finance has to approve spend above $50k and will require the MPA and a short SOW.

Estimate timeline (ballpark):
- MPA review start: this week -> estimated complete ~ 2026-11-30
- Security review: start on receipt of questionnaire -> estimated complete ~ 2026-11-25
- Finance approval / PO issuance: post-legal, expect PO by 2026-12-07 for enterprise deals

I attached the security questionnaire (Cobalt_Sec_Questionnaire_template.pdf). I'll loop George on any legal questions.

Claire

Diego / Vanessa — quick notes:

1) Pilot / card flow: We can take card for pilot up to $50k. Finance is comfortable approving a one-off pilot charge; we just need to capture the billing contact and legal entity on the payment page. No extra approvals if under $50k.

2) PO / enterprise: For anything > $50k or multi-year we must go through the standard PO path. Finance will need the signed MPA and a one-page SOW + cost breakdown. Net30 is standard.

3) Risk / expedite options: If Cobalt wants to start immediately and wants a small pilot, recommend offering the card option now and run the pilot while Legal reviews the MPA. If they need SOC2 scoping details we can provide a redacted report and an architecture diagram (I can attach those).

I'll update pricing-pilot-options.xlsx with the merchant flow info and the SOW stub by end of day. Vanessa — happy to sync for numbers.
